_note: Curated BUILT-IN PastCast events. Read-only in the app; a user's own events live in %LocalAppData%\Anvil\SavedEvents.json. Every start is UTC on a 5-minute mark, every window is one of 30/60/120/180/360/720 minutes, and every leg must pass tools/check_saved_events.py (the archive really holds volumes for that site and window). Each event names its source for the times, and a type (tornado / hurricane / derecho) that groups and filters the list. Each leg's optional key is the moment it is FOR (tornado on the ground / landfall / derecho across a place), from the same source; it must overlap the leg's window.
